subject: grass
name: 草丛
label: 三片小草
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. A simple tuft of three long curved grass blades from one joined base, broad open shapes. Draw flat pure black contour artwork on pure WHITE, NO gray shading, gradients, hatching or fine texture. All interiors completely WHITE. ONE square image with ample margins. Draw only the requested subject/composition. Keep beginner very simple and medium thoughtfully detailed, legible and spacious.
